about: DREAM-1 declined-topic stop (_core.topic_words, _core.same_topic, _core.topic_stopped). Run by plugins/av-events/tests/test_inference_run.py (the plugin, on _core) and scripts/tests/memory-signal-gate.test.ts (the gate, through plugin_core): both sides must give these results.
rule: words: loose_key tokens, minus the fixed stop words (English; Hindi and Hinglish, romanised and Devanagari, with the frame verbs 'dhundh raha', 'seekhna', 'milna', 'ke baare mein jaanna' but not 'main'; a few Tamil, Bengali and Arabic) and tokens with no letter; an ASCII word of 4+ letters is folded to one form for singular and plural: -sses/-ches/-shes/-xes lose 'es', -zzes loses 'zes', -ies of 5+ letters becomes -y, any other -s is dropped (not after ss, us, is); then a singular -ie becomes -y, -che loses its 'e' and -zz loses a 'z' ('movie' = 'movies', 'niche' = 'niches', 'quiz' = 'quizzes'). Known edge: a name in -ie folds onto one in -y ('Julie' = 'July'). same topic: both sets non-empty and 2 x shared >= all (Jaccard >= 1/2). stopped: the candidate is the same topic as 2 or more declined suggestions.
